keyDesignDecisions.decision: The `./display` subpath contains two source files, `buildable.ts` and `wire.ts` (not `buildable-display-vocab.ts` — that filename is retired, not reproduced inside the package), each with a colocated `<name>.test.ts`, plus `index.ts` re-exporting both and two new self-test files (`wire.test.ts` for VOCABULARY invariants, `buildable-kinds.test.ts` for the BuildableDisplayKind exhaustiveness + snapshot). Root `src/index.ts` is NOT touched: no existing subpath (property, encumbrances, og, ...) is re-exported from the root barrel, and display follows that same convention.
keyDesignDecisions.why: Matches the repo's own established subpath convention (verified by reading src/index.ts and src/property/index.ts) rather than inventing a new one; keeps the retirement check in step 4 unambiguous (`git ls-files` for a file literally named `buildable-display-vocab.ts` will only ever match the copies being retired, never this package).

keyDesignDecisions.decision: The nine mcp-app.ts-sourced constants are moved into wire.ts with their local type dependency (mcp-app.ts's `CellState`, used only to type STATE_WORDS) renamed to `PanelPaintState` and left unexported.
keyDesignDecisions.why: mcp-app.ts's `CellState` is a 5-member MCP-panel-local paint-state enum (present/absent-verified/unknown/refused/unread), distinct from and narrower than OPS-21's canonical six-state cell vocabulary that this program elsewhere protects ('Six states. Use no other.'). Exporting a type named `CellState` from the atom-contract package's own `./display` subpath risked being mistaken for, or colliding in spirit with, that canonical vocabulary. Verified this is safe: `vocabulary.ts` never imported the `CellState` type itself, only the `STATE_WORDS` value, so no existing importer is affected by the rename. Will call this out explicitly at CP2/close since it is the one identifier-level deviation from a literal verbatim move.

keyDesignDecisions.decision: VOCABULARY_RESOURCE_URI, buildVocabularyResourceText, registerVocabularyResource, STANDING_VOCAB_BLOCK_TEXT, and STANDING_VOCAB_CONTENT_PART are NOT moved into the package.
keyDesignDecisions.why: Mission text explicitly names these as staying MCP-specific in legacy-design-tools' vocabulary.ts (a thin re-export plus this resource-registration code) in the later consumer-import step. Moving them now would put MCP-transport-shaped code (MCP resource registration signatures) into a substrate package that should not depend on any one server's transport shape.

keyDesignDecisions.decision: The stale '19 entries' comment is corrected to state the real count (34) and pinned by a new exported constant `DOCUMENTED_VOCABULARY_COUNT` plus a test asserting `VOCABULARY.length === DOCUMENTED_VOCABULARY_COUNT`.
keyDesignDecisions.why: Mission explicitly authorizes this exact fix ('the comment count corrected to the real entry count by a test that counts'). No other display string's wording is touched anywhere in this lane.
